rationale: B wins by a slight margin because it finds the payroll story A throws in the trash: "Toast bets restaurant payroll is too messy for generic software" is a real labor/ops lane from the supplied facts. A is cleaner on proof, but its refusal of "Toast payroll solves the tipped-vs-hourly staffing headache for operators" as a "duplicate" is bad judgment; payroll is not borrowing with a different hat. B still needs its collar tightened, especially "The restaurant POS is becoming the restaurant's bank," which outruns the facts.
gaps_in_A: "Toast payroll solves the tipped-vs-hourly staffing headache for operators" is wrongly refused as a "duplicate"; payroll is a separate product, beat, and protagonist from Toast Capital.

"The prevailing belief is that a newly profitable, publicly traded platform lending against its own customers' sales has a clean, well-understood book" invents a market belief the update did not provide.
"newsjack-detector — there is no live news signal in this update" is the wrong next move; the supplied bundling, profitability, and 120,000-location milestone are already the update to pressure-test.
"pivots from hardware to fintech margins" slightly overstates the facts; the update supports bundling and a margin claim, not a proven full pivot.
gaps_in_B: "Toast's path to profit runs through lending" turns correlation into causation; the update says Toast recently reached profitability and says fintech is higher-margin, not that lending drove profit.

"Toast wants to be its restaurants' bank" and "turning point-of-sale into the operating account" are punchy but overcooked; the facts support cash advances and payroll bundling, not banking or operating-account control.
"documented fee complaints" upgrades "some restaurant owners have complained" into stronger sourcing than the update gives, and it does not establish the complaints are about Toast Capital.
"high turnover make restaurant payroll a distinct problem" may be true in the real world, but it is not in the supplied facts; the angle needs that sourced before it leaves the building.
